reviews.text:
After multiple experiences with this business, I can confidently say the biggest problem is the owner. He is consistently rude, dismissive, and incredibly unprofessional. He seems incapable of accepting when he is wrong, and any concern is met with defensiveness and a nasty attitude.

As someone who works in hospitality, I find his lack of basic customer service and professionalism shocking.

I genuinely feel bad for his employees—especially whoever has had the strength and patience to stay and deal with this behavior on a regular basis.

After giving this business multiple chances, I’ve seen enough. I will not be returning and certainly would not recommend it.

The owner is the most rude individual I’ve come across in a long time. Terrible to the employees and has terrible communication skills. I’m unsure how he’s able to operate a business with such a dismissive and rude approach towards customers.

Super professional! The groomers have been grooming for over 20 years. Sam did such an incredible job with my 4 pound Pomeranian. She looks like a little princess!! I love that there’s a bar in here with coffee and mocktails and all the healthy things too. It’s such a great experience. Definitely coming back I love the energy of the space and everyone is so kind.

PLEASE! DO NOT GROOM HERE. Take your fur buddy to any of the other several hundreds of groomers in LA This place has been a consistent miss with groom services and the customers as well. I will not be returning there, or any of their locations.
NOT WORTH THE MONEY. SERVICE WAS NOT GOOD.

PLEASE FIND A NEW OPTION FOR YOUR FUR BABY. THE APPEAL IS ALLURING AND VIBEY....AT FIRST. BUT THE OWNER IS SUPER INAPPROPRIATE AND CRINGE. THIS PLACE IS NOT TO SATISFACTORY IN SERVICE EITHER. LA we are obsessed with our animals, that said there are more reputible places than this one. And that provide A1 services.
Great first grooming experience for our Husky. Nice, clean, professional, and friendly place - definitely recommend.

I want to leave a fair, honest, and balanced review based on my experience at the Sunset location.

Positives:

1. The place was clean, organized, and comfortable.
2. I really liked that the dogs were not kept in cages.
3. They offered one complimentary refreshing drink, as well as coffee.
4. There was a massage chair that I could use while waiting for my dog to finish his bath and grooming.
5. They did not ask me to bring health or rabies vaccination records. This was convenient because I had forgotten the documents, although some customers may consider this a safety concern.

Negatives:

1. The starting price was $119, but the total quickly increased with add-ons. For example, I was told that a poodle-feet style would cost an additional $35.
2. The bath and haircut were fine, but the final result was fairly standard—nothing exceptional or “wow.”
3. They offered a 20% discount for first-time customers, but I was told that I had to review both their Sunset and Santa Monica Boulevard locations to receive it. I had only visited the Sunset location, so I did not feel comfortable reviewing the Santa Monica Boulevard location without ever using its services.
4. They also wanted the reviews submitted before the grooming service was finished. That felt very unusual because customers should see the final result before being asked to leave a review.

Overall, the facility and waiting experience were nice, but the pricing structure and review process could be more transparent. Based on my experience, I would give the Sunset location 4 out of 5 stars.

The owner was super nice and welcoming! We are traveling from Canada and noticed this place on our walk. Very knowledgeable, and could accommodate our needs. Put my partner and I at ease very quickly!
Above & beyond! Absolute gems. Stayed open late to service a big old boy we found on the streets. Just truly amazing humans and dog people!!! So grateful.
After finding an infested stray they made room for me in their schedule the same day and were so kind and caring and giving with their time and effort

Huber did such an amazing job with Sage’s haircut! She looks absolutely adorable and I couldn’t be happier with how she turned out. He really took his time and got everything just right. The place itself is also super cute and has such a fun, welcoming vibe. Sage came out looking like a little superstar. We’ll definitely be back!
Had Alex groomed today. Bath and haircut. Daniel was his groomer. Did a great job!  Alex is ready for a night out in the town!
very clean and welcoming environment really good with pets and the people there are super nice awesome place
10/10 grooming! Great vibe to hang out and work while the pup was in the salon!

Absolutely stellar service from start to finish! They took such amazing care of my baby Oliver and even got us in last minute—which was a total lifesaver. Paul, the owner, is incredibly dedicated and truly cares, and Hubert, the master stylist, is absolutely phenomenal. The founder was also there during our visit and took the time to sit and chat with me while I relaxed in the massage chairs during Oliver’s grooming session—such a unique and enjoyable experience!

We had such a great time that I even signed up for a membership on the spot. I’ll 100% be trusting them with my baby again in the future!

My absolute favorite one and it just does like one and one cage, free kennel, free, grooming and like for this like here it’s like like we love the dogs and then there too but these are guys Becca’s been doing it for 50 years and it’s just absolutely incredible and magic

I love their services. Private and luxury great for my baby because she doesnt get stressed coming here. She is a chill dog but I still dont want her to be stressed coming to a grooming place. At Collar & Comb its a private grooming session and she is so relaxed. Shes so happy coming here. Such a nice place. Will come back everytime we are in LA and will reccommend to friends.

Thank you, Summer, for the 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you took the time to share your experience. It was a pleasure caring for your pup, and we hope to welcome you both back to Collar & Comb again soon. 🐾✨ …
Great spot! Great beverages too!
Grooming can be stressful for my dog but they put her at ease, and she looks great! Highly recommend.
Fantastic grooming shop with a clean, welcoming environment and truly excellent customer service—friendly, attentive staff who made the whole experience easy and stress-free.

I brought my Doberman puppy, Luna, to Collar & Comb and the experience was AMAZING. Anastasia was our groomer and she was so kind, patient, and gentle with Luna. You can tell she truly loves animals and takes pride in her work.

Luna can be a little nervous with new people, but Anastasia made her feel calm and comfortable the whole time. Her coat came out shiny, soft, and smelling great—and she looked so happy afterwards!

The staff was friendly, the salon was super clean, and the whole process felt easy and stress-free. I’m so grateful we found a place we can trust with our pup. We’ll definitely be coming back. 🐾❤️
Incredible experience! My pup is very clean and the whole team took wonderful, attentive care of her. I’ll definitely be back! Great spot!
Very friendly and helpful staff! Super clean establishment and they were very gentle with my dog :)

This place has your animals best interest in mind always. There is no other place I’ll recommend. 10/10. These professionals are committed to going above and beyond to make sure your pets needs are met and prepares them to stay healthy and well!!!
Amazing stuff and solo treatment! Very caring and good coordination as well! Got a full spa treatment with grooming for my 4 year old shihtzu babe!

Treat your fur baby to the luxurious Collar Club in West Hollywood where your baby is not caged. You have one groomer throughout the entire process. A happy place for you and your fur baby. I love it and you will too❤️

I’ve been going to Collar & Comb on Sunset for over three years. My dog’s on a six-week grooming schedule, and while I occasionally reschedule, I always give 48+ hours’ notice - exactly what their policy requires.

Today, when I called to postpone my Friday appointment (well within the 48-hour window), the owner Paul got rude and canceled my entire membership, saying I’d rescheduled more than three times this year and that was “too many.” There’s no written rule about that - he just made one up.

For a place that’s already pretty expensive, you’d expect better treatment. Instead, Paul came across as rude, dismissive, and more focused on fees than loyalty.

Reading through other reviews, I can see the same theme - Paul’s poor attitude and lack of customer care. He’s clearly not interested in running a welcoming business.

If you value respect, flexibility, and professionalism, go elsewhere.
